title: Blind Deaf Mute
description: One of you is blind. One is deaf. One is mute. Now go kill the Ender Dragon — together.
body:
Blind Deaf Muted

  A co-op challenge built on broken communication.

  Three friends. Three disabilities. One dragon to kill.

  Every player is dealt a role — 🔴 Blind, 🟡 Deaf, or 🟣 Muted — and none of you can win alone. The blind player can't see the danger. The deaf
  player can't hear the warning. The muted player knows the answer but can't say it. You'll have to build a chain of trust just to cross a
  bridge — let alone beat the game.

  Features
  - 🎙️ Real enforcement — voice is cut server-side via Simple Voice Chat, not honor-system.
  - 🎰 Role roulette — slot-machine reveals + throwable Randomizer Bottles that re-roll everyone mid-game.
  - 🧑‍🦯 Wearable roles — canes, dark glasses, bandages, headsets so you can spot teammates at a glance.
  - 🛠️ Admin commands — swap roles live. Hardcore or normal.
  - ❤️ Shared health between players

  Install. Suffer. Laugh. Win.
